check: F06 — run-level behaviour when the run-data root fills up MID-RUN
summary: A run already in flight when the root fills does NOT hang: it closes in the DB (stopped) instead of wedging, and the API stays alive (/healthz 200, /readyz 503 data_root_unwritable). But (1) all TrajectoryFileObserver writes fail with ENOSPC and are swallowed by the non-critical-observer isolation, so the trajectory degrades SILENTLY (jsonl empty -> /trace 'unavailable'; the JSON snapshot + summary.json silently corrupt), and (2) a run SUBMITTED while the root is full is accepted (202 queued) and then wedged at 'queued' FOREVER, because _launch's history_path.write_text raises ENOSPC and _drain_session swallows it ('continuing queue') without closing the run row.

observation_a_trajectory_writes.mechanism: frontier_agent/components/observers/trajectory.py TrajectoryFileObserver has critical=False. frontier_agent/core/loop_types.py notify_observers() runs non-critical hooks as background tasks and isolates their exceptions (_handle_observer_error: WARNING on the first failure, DEBUG afterwards). An ENOSPC therefore NEVER propagates to the agent loop and NEVER aborts the run.
engine_log_verbatim_errors: 06:37:44 WARNING ... Observer TrajectoryFileObserver.on_loop_start raised: [Errno 28] No space left on device — subsequent failures DEBUG only (trajectory.py:475 -> _write_jsonl:261)

It does NOT surface the corrupt .json snapshot / 0-byte summary.json degradation, but that is outside its stated contract.

observation_d_api_liveness.gap: the writable-root gate exists on /readyz but is NOT enforced on POST /api/runs, so a full root still yields a 202 + a wedged queued run

defects_found.title: A run submitted while the run-data root is full is accepted (202 queued) then wedged at 'queued' forever
defects_found.evidence: run_id 0ac4fb6974d345acacfe1678908bfa1d: _launch -> history_path.write_text raised ENOSPC; _drain_session swallowed it ('continuing queue'); the runs row never got a terminal status and stayed queued even after space returned
defects_found.impact: the UI shows a run that can never start and never ends; the user is never told the root is full even though /readyz said so

defects_found.title: Trajectory loss on a full root is silent — no run-level signal
defects_found.evidence: run3: every TrajectoryFileObserver hook raised ENOSPC and was swallowed (non-critical observer); react_agent.jsonl ended 0 bytes, /trace 'unavailable', usage 'unavailable' (llm_calls:0) while the run itself closed as a normal 'stopped/no_tool' run with a non-null final_answer
defects_found.impact: the run row presents a successful-looking stopped run whose trace and usage are nevertheless gone; only engine.log carries the reason (one WARNING)

defects_found.title: Silent corruption / orphaned 0-byte sidecars on partial writes
defects_found.evidence: run1: stale react_agent.json (start-only) plus 0-byte react_agent.json.tmp and react_agent.messages.spool; run1 & run3: 0-byte summary.json (worker.py:467 write is unguarded)
